title: M3-05 compliance and security audit

commands.name: security-tests
commands.command: pnpm exec vitest run apps/api/test/security.e2e-spec.ts apps/api/test/security-backup.spec.ts packages/ai/src/redaction.test.ts packages/ai/src/model-key-cipher.test.ts packages/core/src/storage-key.test.ts --maxWorkers=1

commands.name: playwright
commands.command: PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEBSERVER=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3002 pnpm exec playwright test --workers=1
commands.note: Port 3000 was occupied by another worktree, so this worktree used 3002. A pre-existing chapter-generation test timed out once under parallel workers and passed in isolation; the serial full suite passed 30/30.

commands.name: compose-smoke
commands.command: AI_PROVIDER=fake docker compose up -d --build --wait postgres redis mailpit minio api worker web

securityChecks.rowLevelSecurity: enabled and forced on author-owned tables
securityChecks.tenantContext: request transaction and worker job context

dependencyResidualRisk.exposure: MinIO bucket-notification stream parser is not called by NovelBrain.
dependencyResidualRisk.mitigation: Remain on legacy-compatible stream-json 1.9.1; override decode-uri-component to 0.5.1 to close the high advisory; re-evaluate when MinIO updates its parser integration.

deploymentOpenItems: Database, backup and object storage encryption at rest
Application audit trail for login, key changes, exports and deletion
30-day production log retention and access controls
Short-lived signed object download links if direct object storage access is introduced
